column1: # Grounded questions for junit-team/junit5 at commit de6d621.
# The third repository in the corpus and the first Gradle multi-module build. Its 27 source roots
# make module membership a real question rather than a synonym for "the package", and its extension
# model is interface-heavy, which exercises dispatch where jackson exercises generics.
# Ground truth read from the source, not from tool output.
# junit5 uses Isolated Projects, so a root Gradle task cannot aggregate subproject classpaths.
# Produce one file per module and let discovery merge them (95.9% resolution, up from 87.3%):
#   gradle --init-script repo-intel-init.gradle repoIntelClasspath   # script printed by --discover-classpath
# id <TAB> repository <TAB> question <TAB> kind <TAB> subject <TAB> expected names (|) <TAB> expected locations (|) <TAB> min confidence
